content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, located at Ansari Nagar, is an apex healthcare and research institution in India. This recruitment is being conducted under a clinical research project funded by MSD Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. focusing on adult patients with hyperlipidemia. The primary place of work and posting for the recruited coordinator will be AIIMS, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India and fulfill the following eligibility criteria: Essential Qualification: 1st class Graduate / Post Graduate degree in basic science including the integrated PG Degrees. Desirable Qualification: Should have experience in Clinical Drug trial. Age Limit: Upto 30 years. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)
content_sections.text: Prepare an updated Curriculum Vitae (C.V) mentioning educational qualifications, contact information, and relevant clinical trial experience. Compose an email with your application and attach the updated C.V. Send the email to [email protected] . Ensure the email is sent on or before 30 October 2026 , as applications received after the due date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection will be conducted through shortlisting and an interview: Merely fulfilling the minimum prescribed qualification and experience will not vest any right on a candidate for being called for interview. Applications will be shortlisted, and only shortlisted candidates will be called to appear before the duly constituted Selection Committee. The decision of the Selection Committee will be final. The Principal Investigator (P.I.) will not entertain any correspondence or interim enquiries regarding shortlisting or selection. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The primary location for the position will be AIIMS, New Delhi. The post advertised is need-based without any commitment for its filling. The job will be regulated as per the terms of the project and prevailing rules and procedures followed at AIIMS/DHR etc. from time to time. Applications received after the due date (30.10.2026) will not be considered. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates at any stage of the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Clinical Research Coordinator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your C.V via email is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the post of Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the AIIMS CRC post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 1st class Graduate or Post Graduate degree in basic science, including integrated PG degrees.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Clinical Research Coordinator post at AIIMS?
faq.answer: The prescribed age limit is upto 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the CRC post at AIIMS New Delhi?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates submit their application for AIIMS CRC Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their C.V by email to [email protected] latest by 30 October 2026.

faq.answer: Experience in Clinical Drug trials is listed as a desirable qualification, not as an essential requirement.

faq.answer: Applications will be screened and shortlisted candidates will be invited to appear for an interview before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Will any travel allowance (TA/DA) be provided for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be given to candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the project duration for this AIIMS vacancy?
faq.answer: The duration of the project appointment is 1 year.
